title: Inherited a Property? We Get It Ready | Rosa's Sparkling
metaDescription: Full cleanout, light remodeling, decoration and staging for inherited properties in Ocala, Tampa and Spring Hill, FL — ready to sell or ready to keep.
h1: Inherited a house? Leave it to Rosa.
kicker: For heirs and estate property owners
intro: Inheriting a property usually means a house that hasn't been touched in years, on top of everything else you're already handling. From cleaning to light remodeling, interior decoration, and professional staging, I'll get your property ready — whether you're selling it or making it your own.
heroVideoAlt: Video of Rosa's team preparing an inherited property: full cleanout, light remodeling, decoration and staging
whatsappMessage: Hi, I inherited a property and would like help getting it ready

cta.heading: Ready when you are
cta.body: Send us the address on WhatsApp and we'll figure out where to start — cleanout, repairs, or straight to staging.

sections.heading: What's included
sections.body: Every visit covers what an inherited property usually needs:

sections.heading: Who it's for
sections.body: Heirs and estate property owners handling a home that's sat untouched for years — whether you're preparing to sell or planning to move in yourself. If it's sitting vacant in the meantime, our vacant-property care applies too.
